title: Applied LLMs: subject assistants, retrieval and adaptation
summary: 24 detailed lessons in applied LLM systems, from choosing a task to building grounded subject assistants. Study retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning and tools through offline examples and explicitly prepared model workflows.

lessons.title: The subject assistant decision: prompts, retrieval or fine-tuning
lessons.outcome: Route each subject-assistant request to prompting, retrieval, a deterministic tool or fine-tuning, and write a measurable task contract with a held-out family split.
lessons.lab: Describe a request for the current conversion-rate definition requiring a citation.
lessons.verification: route retrieval; reason current cited evidence. contract has exact fields, an abstention policy and a family split.

lessons.title: Data-science task contracts and structured extraction
lessons.outcome: Validate extracted data-science records against type, semantic and provenance checks, rejecting impossible counts and keeping missing values distinct from zero.
lessons.lab: Validate visits 10, purchases 3 and assignment_unit account.
lessons.verification: conversion rate 0.3. invalid unit rejected; account remains explicit.

lessons.title: Prompt and context engineering with measurable boundaries
lessons.outcome: Build a versioned prompt artifact that keeps untrusted evidence as data, reserves response capacity within a context budget and isolates evaluation examples.
lessons.lab: Build a prompt with one metric evidence item and a conversion-rate question.
lessons.verification: separate instruction, evidence and question fields, with template subject-v1. ValueError before context selection.

lessons.title: Corpus provenance, versions and evaluation isolation
lessons.outcome: Build a versioned corpus manifest with source permissions and content hashes, select active versions explicitly and detect family leakage between training and test data.
lessons.lab: Add source=course-authored, permission=course-fixture and SHA256 to each local document.
lessons.verification: 6 complete records; all hashes contain 64 characters. attack text remains data; restricted record remains restricted.

lessons.title: Chunking, overlap, offsets and context budgets
lessons.outcome: Split documents into overlapping chunks whose start and end offsets reproduce the cited source text, and measure the duplication that overlap adds.
lessons.lab: Chunk one two three four five six seven with size 3 and overlap 1.
lessons.verification: chunks one two three, three four five and five six seven. empty list for empty text; one short chunk for the two-token source.

lessons.title: Lexical retrieval and BM25 from first principles
lessons.outcome: Compute BM25 scores from term frequency, inverse document frequency and length normalization, and rank a small corpus with deterministic ties.
lessons.lab: Rank documents a=account randomization, b=visit counts and c=account outcomes for the query randomization.
lessons.verification: a ranks first with a positive score; the other scores are 0. empty result for no documents; finite zero score for an empty document.

lessons.title: Embedding retrieval, similarity and representation limits
lessons.outcome: Rank documents by cosine similarity between embedding vectors, reject zero or incompatible vectors, and show where geometric rank fails to establish relevance.
lessons.lab: Use query[1, 0, 0] and documents purchase[1, .1, 0], geometry[0, 1, 0], mixed[.5, .5, 0].
lessons.verification: purchase ranks first, mixed second, geometry last. top-ranked ID wrong is outside the authored relevant set.

lessons.title: Hybrid retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion and reranking
lessons.outcome: Combine lexical and dense rankings with reciprocal rank fusion, rerank a bounded candidate set and measure the candidate-recall ceiling.
lessons.lab: Fuse lexical[a, b, c] and dense[b, d, a] with constant 60.
lessons.verification: b ranks first, a second. ValueError for nonpositive constant; TypeError for non-string ID.

lessons.title: Metadata filtering and access-controlled retrieval
lessons.outcome: Enforce access-scope filters before retrieval scoring so restricted documents never reach answer context, cache keys or traces.
lessons.lab: Give a public-only request the six-document corpus and inspect admitted IDs.
lessons.verification: private-v1 absent before ranking. trace contains only public document IDs.

lessons.title: Query rewriting and bounded multi-hop retrieval
lessons.outcome: Rewrite queries with a controlled synonym rule and follow linked evidence within a declared hop budget without crossing authorization boundaries.
lessons.lab: Rewrite buy rate using buy->purchase while preserving the original question.
lessons.verification: rewrittenpurchase rate; original unchanged. restricted document never appears.

lessons.title: Grounded claims, citations and evidence-based abstention
lessons.outcome: Map each answer claim to a cited, version-bound evidence span, and abstain when no admitted source supports it.
lessons.lab: Answer the conversion-definition question from the metric document and its first sentence.
lessons.verification: status answered; one claim; citation slices the exact sentence. rate.3 with input counts preserved.

lessons.title: Evaluating retrieval and answers with oracle controls
lessons.outcome: Evaluate retrieval recall, reciprocal rank and answer support separately, and use oracle-context controls to locate where a pipeline failed.
lessons.lab: Use relevant IDs a, c and retrieved b, c, a.
lessons.verification: recall 1; reciprocal rank 0.5. duplicate ID detected.

lessons.title: Paired reliability studies and family-aware uncertainty
lessons.outcome: Compare two assistants with paired, family-level bootstrap uncertainty, report coverage alongside answered accuracy and block severe boundary failures.
lessons.lab: Use system A errors q1=0, q2=0, q3=1 and B q1=1, q2=1, q3=0.
lessons.verification: differences[-1, -1, 1] by sortedID. test-based selection rejected.

lessons.title: Supervised fine-tuning data and answer-target masks
lessons.outcome: Construct supervised fine-tuning records with answer-only target masks, detect destructive truncation and keep example families disjoint across splits.
lessons.lab: Use prompt IDs[1, 2] and answer IDs[5, 6, 3].
lessons.verification: inputs[1, 2, 5, 6]; labels[-100, 5, 6, 3]; 3 active targets. record excluded despite valid token arrays.

lessons.title: Full supervised fine-tuning of a tiny causal decoder
lessons.outcome: Train a tiny causal decoder with full supervised fine-tuning on masked answer targets, then evaluate a frozen held-out prompt and record an honest receipt.
lessons.lab: Use sequences [1, 2, 5, 3] and [1, 4, 6, 3], masking the first shifted target.
lessons.verification: inputs shape (2, 3); labels [[-100, 5, 3], [-100, 6, 3]]; 4 active targets. receipt says 20 updates, 4 active training targets and no natural-language competence claim.

lessons.title: Low-rank adaptation: dimensions, gradients and a real update
lessons.outcome: Implement a LoRA update on a frozen linear weight, count its stored parameters, take an adapter-only gradient step and verify the merged weight.
lessons.lab: Construct W=I8, A=ones(8, 2)/8, B=zeros(2, 8), rank 2 and alpha 4, then count stored entries.
lessons.verification: 64 base entries, 32 trainable adapter entries and scale 2. The actual update has rank 1, within the configured bound 2; alpha 4 gives twice the alpha-2 delta.

lessons.title: Quantized frozen bases, adapter gradients and QLoRA limits
lessons.outcome: Apply 4-bit quantization to a frozen base matrix, pack and dequantize its codes, train only a low-rank adapter and account for storage honestly.
lessons.lab: QuantizeW[[.1, -.9], [1.7, -.2]] with scale 1.7/7 andnearest-even rounding.
lessons.verification: codes[[0, -4], [7, -1]]. all four unimplemented claims explicitly False.

lessons.title: Compare full and adapter fine-tuning on frozen tasks
lessons.outcome: Compare full and adapter fine-tuning from one cloned base under fixed update budgets, prove base preservation and evaluate the same frozen held-out task.
lessons.lab: Create a seed 31 decoder and copy its state into full and adapted candidates.
lessons.verification: all initial base parameters equal. adapter 96 entries; 20 updates each; scope literal-token task.

lessons.title: Preference optimization, DPO and the RLHF distinction
lessons.outcome: Compute a DPO-style preference loss and its gradient from policy and reference margins, and distinguish that offline update from a complete RLHF workflow.
lessons.lab: Set policy difference 0, reference difference 0, beta 0.5.
lessons.verification: loss log 2. offline update True; reward_model_trained False; online_rl False.

lessons.title: Fine-tuning embeddings and a small reranker
lessons.outcome: Train a query projection with a contrastive objective and a small pairwise reranker, then check held-out scores and detect false-negative identities.
lessons.lab: Use queries and documents equal to the 2-by-2 identity matrix, with positive labels 0, 1.
lessons.verification: score shape (2, 2); one positive per query. actual gradient updates True; pretrained_semantic_encoder False.

lessons.title: Optional pretrained-model adaptation with pinned offline artifacts
lessons.outcome: Inspect an optional pretrained-model recipe, tracing pinned revision, license, chat-template boundaries and trainer labels before any offline training run.
lessons.lab: Read the supplied model manifest and identify model ID, revision and license note before any download.
lessons.verification: exact 40-character revision and Apache-2.0 card note are present. pretrained execution unverified; no generated success receipt.

lessons.title: Structured tools for extraction, aggregation and data-science work
lessons.outcome: Dispatch only typed, bounded data-science tool requests, reject invalid values and excess work, and verify generated explanations against computed results.
lessons.lab: Use rows A1, A3, B10 and the admittedgroup_mean request.
lessons.verification: A count 2 mean 2; B count 1 mean 10. descriptive statistic available; causal claim not established.

lessons.title: Domain assistant boundaries: freshness, injection, budgets and traces
lessons.outcome: Enforce freshness, call-budget and allowlisted-trace controls around a domain assistant, using an injected UTC clock and abstaining on stale evidence.
lessons.lab: Use fixed UTC now 2026-10-22 and a document published one day earlier under a two-day limit.
lessons.verification: fresh True. answer admission False; reason stale evidence.

lessons.title: Capstone: a grounded and evaluated data-science subject assistant
lessons.outcome: Assemble an end-to-end subject assistant that enforces access, grounds or abstains, computes results deterministically and passes a bounded acceptance evaluation.
lessons.lab: Ask the public assistant forconversion_definition.
lessons.verification: answered with metric-v1 citation and source text. local_fixture_pass True; production_go no-go.
